September 21,2026



Re: Recommendation Letter for Rhodas Demissew Tadesse



To Whom It May Concern,

It is my pleasure to recommend Rhodas Demissew Tadesse, who has worked with Dr. Nega
Education Center (DNEC) since July 2025 as a full-stack developer and administrator of our
Moodle-based learning management system. Among the developers I have worked with, Rhodas
stands out for his discipline, his clear communication, and his understanding of what end users
actually need.

Rhodas builds our platform with the learner in mind. He has set up courses for every grade level
from 1 to 12 and adapted the design to each stage. Courses for the lower grades are more interactive
and engaging for younger children, while those for the upper grades are more structured and suited
to independent study. He also made the platform more inclusive by adding text-to-speech, so
learners who cannot see the screen can still follow the content. Behind this sits the technical work
that keeps  the platform dependable. He configures user  roles, permissions, and learning
workflows, customizes themes and navigation, and manages the database, scheduled tasks,
backups, security, automation, and reporting. Because he understands both what learners need and
how the system must run to serve them, he can take responsibility for the platform from end to
end.

A good example of his problem-solving is the Student Information System he built for us. Rhodas
noticed that although grades were already recorded in Moodle, there was no simple, centralized
way for administrators, teachers, and students to work with that information. His solution was a
Student Information System that pulls grade data from the LMS into one place and presents it in a
clear, role-specific view. He built it in just two weeks, making grades easier for administrators to
manage, teachers to follow, and students to check.

He consistently completes his tasks ahead of deadlines. When a request is unclear, he asks for
clarification before starting, and he keeps us informed about the progress and status of his work.
Because he works remotely, this reliability makes it easy for us to plan around him and trust that
work will be done.

Rhodas is a disciplined full-stack developer who communicates clearly, works well independently,
and thinks about the people who use what he builds. I recommend him without reservation and am

confident he would be a strong asset to any team or organization. Please feel free to contact me if
additional information is required.

Sincerely,
Nega
